paragraphs: Engage by Cell sells mobile engagement tools that let an organization reach people instantly through text messaging and mobile web apps. The company describes its buyers as businesses, non-profits, government entities and educational institutions.

Texting runs from a web-based dashboard with a personalized text code, so staff can send real-time or automated messages. The mobile website builder uses a drag-and-drop interface that lets anyone update content, with no app store approvals or downloads required. A dial-in audio guide product supplies a phone number hosted on a dashboard for recording and uploading prompts. Other listed tools include wayfinding maps, geofencing and ride booking.
The site presents case studies from organizations including the Atlanta Botanical Garden. The company states that it is TX-RAMP certified and that an accessibility report is available.

quote.text: No app store approvals or downloads are required.
